title: Command R changes a picked clip's speed, as in Premiere
goal: In Premiere, Command R on a picked clip opens its speed. Here Command R does nothing on a video, and changing a clip's speed means finding the Speed dropdown in the panel or the Clip menu's Speed list. Speeding up a slow stretch is one of the commonest moves on a screen recording, so give it Premiere's key.
notes:
Command R is unbound on a video today: grep of Sources/Photonz for keyboardShortcut("r" finds only Command Shift R (EditorCommands.swift ~1839). Photoshop uses Command R for Rulers; check the app has no rulers row that should own it, and if it does, keep it on pictures and take it on a video the way Command K is taken.

Speed lives in three places: the Clip menu's Speed submenu (EditorCommands.swift ~819-831, freezeAndSpeedRows), the clip's right-click Speed submenu (EditorState+TimelineMenus.swift ~144), and the panel's Speed dropdown (SpeedInspector.swift ~93, .playtestField("Speed")). A submenu row cannot carry a key, so the menu side probably wants a Speed... row above the submenu or the key printed on the submenu's own title if AppKit allows; decide and say which in the audit. No new control: Premiere's typed Speed/Duration dialog is NOT in scope, and a typed speed box would be a new control needing a card.

Found by the Premiere key gap check this pass (docs/design/video-vs-premiere.md, key reference docs/design/video.md 249-289). Searched: speed duration, command r: nothing.
acceptance: With a clip or a piece picked, Command R opens that clip's speed choices where they already live (the panel's Speed dropdown), showing the panel's Time section if it is folded or the panel is hidden, and picking a speed works as it does today
With nothing picked, Command R names what it needs in the usual notice, or the menu row is dimmed, and changes nothing
The Clip menu shows Command R on its speed row, so the key can be learned from the menu
On a picture (not a video) Command R keeps whatever it does there today
Ships at Next defaults; the try path is: open a recording, press B at two seconds, click the second piece, press Command R, pick 2x

audit written under queue/audits/ and the key added to docs/design/video-vs-premiere.md, and anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar and written into this task log if it does not
